episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: Yuko receives a letter from an unknown sender. It is an invitation to an auction. Seven avid collectors were invited to an old mansion. They all admit that they accepted the invitation to complete their collections. They waited for the host, but he does not make an appearance. And one by one the collectors disappear. The strange host and a mysterious girl. A night where odd things happen one after another. What is being auctioned? Who is the host? The cunning and foolish people who are obsessed with possessions and the host's timeless passion. What is waiting at the end of this enigmatic series of riddles? And what is the conclusion of the sad love story behind them? Mystery leads to mystery, and reaches the unexpected!

episodes.title: Another Peak to Climb
episodes.synopsis: Vowing to win against Tamamo Cross after her fall Tenno Sho defeat, Oguri Cap throws herself into training. Her classmates soon inquire about her next race, prompting Dicta Striker to challenge her directly. Dicta Striker insists that Oguri Cap compete in the same race as her, aiming to prove that focusing solely on Tamamo Cross is a mistake. Ultimately, Oguri Cap decides her next race will be…

episodes.title: Our Story
episodes.synopsis: Fumino Nase, a trainer already hailed as a genius at her young age, declares her intent to enter her trainee, Super Creek, in the Kikuka Sho. Among their competition is the winner of the Satsuki Sho, Yaeno Muteki. In this battle across 3,000 meters, only one racer can win. Will it be one of these two?

episodes.title: The World`s Best
episodes.synopsis: The international G1 event, the Japan Cup, is fast approaching. One by one, the participating Umamusume trickle into Japan from all over the world, including the Italian champion of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, Toni Bianca. Ever vigilant, Musaka sends Belno Light on an undercover mission with one goal—learn as much as she can about their opponents. Among these racers, Belno Light happens upon a particularly odd one...

episodes.title: The Japan Cup
episodes.synopsis: Stepping onto the turf at the Japan Cup, Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross are reunited for the first time since the fall Tenno Sho. Face to face with her rival, Oguri Cap declares that she will win the Japan Cup. As each racer reaffirms their hopes for the race, an ominous smile spreads across Obey Your Master's face…

episodes.title: The Wild Joker
episodes.synopsis: There once was an earnest Umamusume who gave racing her all, but had nothing to show for it. Still, she craved victory more than any other, so one day, she made a choice. She'd bet everything on a single race across the Pacific. In order to win there, she'd don the joker's mask and sacrifice everything—even herself—to become a true wild card.

episodes.title: A Zone Yet Unknown
episodes.synopsis: Outclassed by Tamamo Cross and Obey Your Master's use of the Zone, Oguri Cap suffers another bitter defeat at the Japan Cup. Her confidence takes a hit as she feels the gap between her and Tamamo Cross now more than ever, and she begins to wonder if she'll ever best her rival. That's when Musaka decides to rally a task force to reignite Oguri Cap's fighting spirit.

episodes.title: The Answer
episodes.synopsis: Oguri Cap, Dicta Striker, Super Creek, and the other Arima Kinen participants have gathered for a press conference regarding the race. Tamamo Cross arrives late with a solemn expression. She pulls Oguri Cap aside, revealing that she's made a very difficult decision… But just how will Oguri Cap react?

episodes.title: The Arima Kinen
episodes.synopsis: The Arima Kinen has arrived. As Tamamo Cross and her trainer, Komiyama, brace for her last race, they reminisce about their time together. Meanwhile, Oguri Cap has finally overcome the depression from her greatest rival's imminent departure, replaced by an overwhelming desire to seize victory. With a lineup including Dicta Striker, Super Creek, and many other generational talents, this year's Arima Kinen is shaping up to be an explosive send-off to an incredible year.

episodes.title: Gray Phantom
episodes.synopsis: Tamamo Cross catches everyone off guard by accelerating in the backstretch instead of the final straight. As Tamamo Cross passes racers one by one, Oguri Cap presses on, ever conscious of Tamamo Cross's looming approach. With her body pushed to the limit, Oguri Cap's mind begins to wander to her past…

episodes.title: A New Era
episodes.synopsis: Oguri Cap has bested the best and emerged victorious at the Arima Kinen over Tamamo Cross. But when one race ends, another is bound to begin… For now, however, Oguri Cap and company decide to relish the holiday season with a party, reflecting on the past year.

info.title: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord
info.synopsis: Van, il quarto figlio di un marchese, a solo due anni inizia a ricordare la sua vita precedente da normale impiegato giapponese. Con la mente di un adulto nel corpo di un bambino, viene considerato da tutti un prodigio...o almeno così è stato finché, all'età di otto anni, sviluppa l'abilità della "Magia di Produzione". In una famiglia che predilige le magie offensive, questa abilità artigianale viene considerata inutile per le battaglie e Van finisce per essere esiliato dal padre in un remoto villaggio di frontiera. Con solo poche persone al seguito, tra cui la sua cameriera personale, i suoi ricordi della vita passata e la sua magia "inutile", riuscirà Van a migliorare le sorti di questo piccolo villaggio...e se stesso?

episodes.title: A Cry from the Heart
episodes.synopsis: In the year 199X, the world was ravaged by nuclear fire, and it seemed humanity had been destroyed. Yet people survived, fighting bitterly over the last remnants of water and food. In this age ruled by violence, a lone man staggers across the wasteland, barely clinging to life.

episodes.title: A Better Tomorrow
episodes.synopsis: As Kenshiro, successor to Hokuto Shinken, travels the wasteland with Bat, they witness an old man being chased by a gang of armed thugs. The thugs are after the precious seed rice the old man is protecting. Ignoring Bat's warning, Kenshiro moves in to save him, but the gang's leader, Spade, fires a crossbow straight at Kenshiro!!

episodes.title: Southern Cross
episodes.synopsis: Kenshiro and Bat arrive in Southern Cross, the stronghold of the King Army, infamous for its countless atrocities. Waiting for nightfall, they slip into the city, where they witness Club—one of King’s men— brutally tormenting innocent slaves. Confronted with this cruelty, Kenshiro unleashes the power of Hokuto Shinken!!

episodes.title: Flames of Obsession
episodes.synopsis: Kenshiro finally reaches his long-standing nemesis: Shin, the successor to Nanto Koshuken and the man known as King. Fueled by the fire of revenge, Kenshiro suddenly finds himself facing Heart, one of Shin’s loyal henchmen. The massive Heart, known as the Destroyer of Fists, is protected by layers of thick fat that render Hokuto Shinken ineffective. Kenshiro is driven into a desperate, life threatening corner...but can he find a way to turn the tide!?

episodes.title: Bloody Cross
episodes.synopsis: Kenshiro burns with rage toward Shin, the man who stole his beloved fiancée Yuria. Shin is stunned by the transformation of the Kenshiro now standing before him. Realizing the battle is turning against him, Shin resorts to a terrifying act. At last, the long and bitter feud between Shin and Kenshiro nears its final reckoning!!

episodes.title: God`s Land
episodes.synopsis: Rin is captured by the fanatical fighting group Golan.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Assassin
episodes.synopsis: Kenshiro goes solo into their headquarter, God's Land. There he encounters Mad Sarge, the brutal instructor who trains Golan's soldiers. Once a member of the elite Red Berets and famed for his deadly combat skills, Mad Sarge leads his troops in a fullforce assault on Kenshiro!!

episodes.title: Messenger from the Homeland
episodes.synopsis: While Kenshiro is at a bar, a group of rugged men appear and try to recruit him into their ranks. Kenshiro easily drives them off, but moments later, a grimy young boy walks into the bar. His name is Taki, a boy who once lived with Bat in a desolate village.

episodes.title: The Mad Dogs Must Die
episodes.synopsis: Toyo, a compassionate old woman, has taken in countless orphaned children and showers them with unconditional love. Kenshiro deeply respects her kindness, especially toward Bat and Rin, whom she treats no differently from the others. But after Kenshiro and his companions leave the village late at night, a terrible danger approaches.

episodes.title: Devil Rebirth
episodes.synopsis: Kenshiro burns with overwhelming fury at the monstrous cruelty Jackal inflicted on Toyo. Swearing he will have his revenge, he begins closing in on Jackal and his gang step by step. Driven into terror by Kenshiro's relentless pursuit, Jackal makes a desperate move-he frees "Devil Rebirth," a demonic giant who had been imprisoned in a penitentiary.

episodes.title: A Man of Nanto
episodes.synopsis: A woman appears before him: Mamiya, who bears a striking resemblance to his lost love, Yuria. Meanwhile, outside the village, a beautiful man-so striking he could be mistaken for a woman-roams the wasteland in search of the man marked with seven scars on his chest!!

episodes.title: Men Who Saw Her Tears
episodes.synopsis: Koh's life is taken by the Fang Clan, yet Mamiya stands firm before the villagers. But when she is alone, away from prying eyes, she quietly weeps for her fallen younger brother. Kenshiro and Rei set off in pursuit of the Fang Clan, who stole Koh's belongings as they fled...and now the fists of Hokuto and Nanto are about to explode!!

episodes.title: A Bloody Trap
episodes.synopsis: Fang Clan Chieftain uses Airi, the sister Rei has been searching for, and takes her hostage, as leverage to bend Rei to his will. When Rei finally reunites with his sister after so long, he is devastated by how much she has changed and loses control of himself. Kenshiro tries desperately to calm Rei...but the situation spirals toward danger.

episodes.title: The One Who Laughs Last
episodes.synopsis: With Airi taken hostage, Rei is ordered by Fang Clan Chieftain to kill Kenshiro. Kenshiro urges him not to fall for Fang Clan Chieftain's manipulations, but Rei, desperate to protect the sister he cherishes above all else, takes a fighting stance against him. The clash between Kenshiro and Rei-Hokuto Shinken versus Nanto Suichoken-is about to erupt!!

info.title: Victoria of Many Faces
info.synopsis: In un'epoca in cui gli agenti operano nell'ombra, Chloe del Regno di Hagur trascorre le sue giornate portando a termine con successo missione dopo missione, grazie alle sue impareggiabili doti di travestimento e alle abilità nelle arti marziali. Dopo il tradimento del suo superiore, decide però di cambiare completamente vita: Chloe sceglie di abbandonare il passato e rinascere come una semplice cittadina, con il nome di Victoria, nel vicino Regno di Ashberry, desiderosa di vivere finalmente un'esistenza normale e felice. Eppure, il suo primo giorno da "Victoria" prende subito una piega inaspettata: per una coincidenza diventa la tutrice di una bambina e inizia così a intrecciare legami con molte nuove persone. Ben presto, però, le ombre tornano ad avvicinarsi: uomini misteriosi si muovono all’ordine del Secondo Principe, mentre la minaccia di un’organizzazione nascosta torna a farsi sentire.

episodes.title: Free, Unbound by Anyone
episodes.synopsis: Chloe decides to leave her life as an agent behind to start over as "Victoria Sellars" and seek her happiness.

episodes.title: No One Should Feel Sorry for Me
episodes.synopsis: After finding a job and a place, Victoria is reunited with Jeffrey.

episodes.title: I Couldn`t Become Someone to Be Depended Upon
episodes.synopsis: Victoria and Jeffrey attend the royal ball, and an incident happens.

episodes.title: Are You Going to Arrest Me?
episodes.synopsis: After being followed, Victoria takes down a mysterious man in mask.

episodes.title: Prepared to Pay for What I`ve Done
episodes.synopsis: Victoria gets the attacker from the dance party out of prison.

episodes.title: Think About This Child`s Happiness
episodes.synopsis: Just when Victoria seems to be gaining allies, a Barone shows up and asks to adopt Nonna.

episodes.title: I Made Great Memories
episodes.synopsis: Nonna comes back, but Victoria makes a decision to leave.

episodes.title: I`m Truly Thankful
episodes.synopsis: Victoria and Nonna live in Randall under aliases, and Jeffrey resign his job to find Victoria.

episodes.title: No Matter What Happens in the Future
episodes.synopsis: Jeffrey finds Victoria at the Cadiz summer festival, and they confess their secrets to each other.
